Word Bingo.text: Listen to the word, find it on the board, and tap it. Find five in a row to win. Tap the speaker to hear the word again.

Picture Pairs.text: Turn over two cards. Remember the pictures and find all the matching pairs.

Math Drops.text: Solve the math problem before the raindrop reaches the water. Type your answer and press enter, or use the number buttons and tap Go.

Word Builder.text: Listen to the word and put the letters in order. Tap or drag the letters, or type them. Press enter to check your word.

Fraction Café.text: Choose the equal pieces needed to make the fraction in the order, then serve your customer.

Number Trail.text: Start on the marked number. Count the hops forward or backward, then choose where you land.

Jungle Jigsaw.text: Choose a world, picture, and puzzle size. Drag the pieces into place to complete the picture.
